# MCP tools

The tools Folio offers to AI assistants, over HTTP (in the app) and stdio (the bridge). Write tools run only when **Let AI edit notes** is on. *App only* tools need the app to be open.

| Tool | Writes | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `list_notes` | no | List Markdown notes in the workspace, most recently modified first. |
| `read_note` | no | Read the full Markdown of a note, or a line range. |
| `search_notes` | no | Full-text search across every note. Returns paths and matching lines with line numbers. |
| `get_outline` | no | Return the heading structure of a note with line numbers. |
| `get_format_guide` | no | Return the syntax of Folio document types: slides-md (.slides.md, Marp compatible), board-md (.board.md diagrams), sheet-md (.sheet.md spreadsheets), or the guide to building slide templates (type template: colours, fonts, masters with placeholders, variants; templates live in Templates/). |
| `get_sheet_values` | no | Evaluate every formula in a .sheet.md note and return each sheet as a grid of computed values, with cell addresses. |
| `get_open_note` *(app only)* | no | Return the note the user has open in Folio right now, its unsaved text and the current selection. |
| `create_note` | yes | Create a new note. Fails if the path already exists. |
| `write_note` | yes | Replace the entire content of a note (creates it if missing). Prefer edit_note for small changes. |
| `edit_note` | yes | Apply exact find-and-replace edits to a note. Each oldText must match exactly once unless replaceAll is set. |
| `append_to_note` | yes | Append Markdown to the end of a note, or to the end of the section under a given heading. |
| `resolve_ref` | no | Compute what a Folio reference points at, as Folio would show it: a sheet cell value or range, a slide title, a board shape label, or a page section. Reference syntax: "Doc#part", e.g. "Budget.sheet#Summary!B7", "Pitch.slides#3", "System.board#api", "Roadmap#Goals". |
| `get_backlinks` | no | List every link ([[..]]), live value ({{..}}) and embed (![[..]]) in the workspace that points at a document. |
| `find_broken_links` | no | List references whose target document does not exist, in one document or the whole workspace. |
| `move_note` | yes | Move or rename a note inside the workspace. References to it in other documents are updated. |
| `open_note` *(app only)* | no | Open a note in Folio so the user sees it, optionally scrolled to a line. |
| `list_slides` | no | List the slides of a deck: number, title, layout, section, hidden, transition, number of placed objects and animations, and whether it has speaker notes. |
| `list_slide_objects` | no | List the placed objects on a slide with id, kind, geometry in px (the slide is 1280×720 for 16:9), attributes, text and link. Use the ids with the other slide tools. |
| `add_object` | yes | Place an object on a slide at x, y, w, h (px). kind: box, shape, line, icon, media, path, smartart, zoom. attrs are slides-md attributes (fill, stroke, border, radius, size, color, font, align, valign, type for shapes, name for icons, link, …). text is Markdown for boxes and shapes. For an image use kind=image with attrs.src. Returns the new id. |
| `move_object` | yes | Change the position, size or rotation of an object (px, degrees). Give only what changes. |
| `restyle_object` | yes | Set or remove attributes of an object: a value sets it, null removes it. Also sets its Markdown text when text is given. |
| `remove_object` | yes | Remove an object from a slide, with any animation of it. |
| `set_animations` | yes | Replace the build order of a slide. Each line: target (#id or body), effect, then trigger (click, with, after), duration (0.5s), delay=, repeat=, by=paragraph. Effects: appear, fade-in, zoom-in, grow-in, fly-in-left, fly-in-right, fly-in-up, fly-in-down, float-in, wipe-in, spin-in, bounce-in, pulse, spin, grow, teeter, flash, shake, disappear, fade-out, zoom-out, fly-out-left, fly-out-right, fly-out-up, fly-out-down, wipe-out, path-left, path-right, path-up, path-down, path-arc, path-custom. An empty list removes all animations. |
| `set_transition` | yes | Set the transition into a slide, or for every slide with slide omitted. Name and optional duration, e.g. "push-left 0.6s"; "none" removes it. Names: none, fade, fade-black, dissolve, push-left, push-right, push-up, push-down, wipe-left, wipe-right, wipe-up, wipe-down, cover-left, cover-right, uncover-left, uncover-right, split, reveal, zoom, zoom-out, iris, clock, blinds, flip, cube, fall, morph. Morph moves objects with the same id between consecutive slides. |
| `rewrite_links` | yes | Change every object link= in a deck from one target to another (e.g. "slide:4" to "slide:6", or an old web address). Returns how many changed. |
| `set_alt_text` | yes | Set the alternative text read by screen readers for a picture, icon, chart or diagram object. Write what the picture shows and why it matters, in one or two sentences. |
| `set_speaker_notes` | yes | Replace the speaker notes of a slide (plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines). |
| `get_design_ideas` | no | Suggest layouts for a slide from its content (the same ideas the Designer pane shows). Returns idea ids and labels; apply one with apply_design_idea. |
| `apply_design_idea` | yes | Replace a slide with one of the layouts from get_design_ideas. Its text is kept. |

## `list_notes`

List Markdown notes in the workspace, most recently modified first.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `folder` | string | no | Sub-folder to list, relative to the workspace |
| `limit` | integer | no |  |

## `read_note`

Read the full Markdown of a note, or a line range.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | e.g. "projects/roadmap.md" |
| `fromLine` | integer | no |  |
| `toLine` | integer | no |  |

## `search_notes`

Full-text search across every note. Returns paths and matching lines with line numbers.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | yes |  |
| `regex` | boolean | no |  |
| `caseSensitive` | boolean | no |  |
| `folder` | string | no |  |
| `limit` | integer | no |  |

## `get_outline`

Return the heading structure of a note with line numbers.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |

## `get_format_guide`

Return the syntax of Folio document types: slides-md (.slides.md, Marp compatible), board-md (.board.md diagrams), sheet-md (.sheet.md spreadsheets), or the guide to building slide templates (type template: colours, fonts, masters with placeholders, variants; templates live in Templates/).

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `slides`, `board`, `sheet`, `template`, `all` | no |  |

## `get_sheet_values`

Evaluate every formula in a .sheet.md note and return each sheet as a grid of computed values, with cell addresses.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `sheet` | string | no | Sheet name; all sheets when omitted |

## `get_open_note`

Return the note the user has open in Folio right now, its unsaved text and the current selection.

No arguments.

## `create_note`

Create a new note. Fails if the path already exists.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Relative path ending in .md |
| `content` | string | yes |  |

## `write_note`

Replace the entire content of a note (creates it if missing). Prefer edit_note for small changes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `content` | string | yes |  |

## `edit_note`

Apply exact find-and-replace edits to a note. Each oldText must match exactly once unless replaceAll is set.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `edits` | array | yes |  |

## `append_to_note`

Append Markdown to the end of a note, or to the end of the section under a given heading.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `content` | string | yes |  |
| `underHeading` | string | no |  |

## `resolve_ref`

Compute what a Folio reference points at, as Folio would show it: a sheet cell value or range, a slide title, a board shape label, or a page section. Reference syntax: "Doc#part", e.g. "Budget.sheet#Summary!B7", "Pitch.slides#3", "System.board#api", "Roadmap#Goals".

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | string | yes |  |
| `from` | string | no | Path of the document containing the reference, for relative names |

List every link ([[..]]), live value ({{..}}) and embed (![[..]]) in the workspace that points at a document.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  |

List references whose target document does not exist, in one document or the whole workspace.

## `list_slides`

List the slides of a deck: number, title, layout, section, hidden, transition, number of placed objects and animations, and whether it has speaker notes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |

## `list_slide_objects`

List the placed objects on a slide with id, kind, geometry in px (the slide is 1280×720 for 16:9), attributes, text and link. Use the ids with the other slide tools.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | yes | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |

## `add_object`

Place an object on a slide at x, y, w, h (px). kind: box, shape, line, icon, media, path, smartart, zoom. attrs are slides-md attributes (fill, stroke, border, radius, size, color, font, align, valign, type for shapes, name for icons, link, …). text is Markdown for boxes and shapes. For an image use kind=image with attrs.src. Returns the new id.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | yes | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
| `kind` | `box`, `shape`, `line`, `icon`, `media`, `path`, `smartart`, `zoom`, `image` | yes |  |
| `x` | number | yes |  |
| `y` | number | yes |  |
| `w` | number | yes |  |
| `h` | number | yes |  |
| `text` | string | no |  |
| `attrs` | object | no |  |
| `id` | string | no | Object id without the # |

## `move_object`

Change the position, size or rotation of an object (px, degrees). Give only what changes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | yes | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
| `id` | string | yes | Object id without the # |
| `x` | number | no |  |
| `y` | number | no |  |
| `w` | number | no |  |
| `h` | number | no |  |
| `rotate` | number | no |  |

## `restyle_object`

Set or remove attributes of an object: a value sets it, null removes it. Also sets its Markdown text when text is given.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | yes | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
| `id` | string | yes | Object id without the # |
| `attrs` | object | no |  |
| `text` | string | no |  |

## `remove_object`

Remove an object from a slide, with any animation of it.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | yes | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
| `id` | string | yes | Object id without the # |

## `set_animations`

Replace the build order of a slide. Each line: target (#id or body), effect, then trigger (click, with, after), duration (0.5s), delay=, repeat=, by=paragraph. Effects: appear, fade-in, zoom-in, grow-in, fly-in-left, fly-in-right, fly-in-up, fly-in-down, float-in, wipe-in, spin-in, bounce-in, pulse, spin, grow, teeter, flash, shake, disappear, fade-out, zoom-out, fly-out-left, fly-out-right, fly-out-up, fly-out-down, wipe-out, path-left, path-right, path-up, path-down, path-arc, path-custom. An empty list removes all animations.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | yes | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
| `animations` | array | yes |  |

## `set_transition`

Set the transition into a slide, or for every slide with slide omitted. Name and optional duration, e.g. "push-left 0.6s"; "none" removes it. Names: none, fade, fade-black, dissolve, push-left, push-right, push-up, push-down, wipe-left, wipe-right, wipe-up, wipe-down, cover-left, cover-right, uncover-left, uncover-right, split, reveal, zoom, zoom-out, iris, clock, blinds, flip, cube, fall, morph. Morph moves objects with the same id between consecutive slides.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | no | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
| `transition` | string | yes |  |

## `rewrite_links`

Change every object link= in a deck from one target to another (e.g. "slide:4" to "slide:6", or an old web address). Returns how many changed.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `from` | string | yes |  |
| `to` | string,null | yes | null removes the links |

|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |
| `slide` | integer | yes | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
| `id` | string | yes | Object id without the # |
| `alt` | string | yes |  |

Suggest layouts for a slide from its content (the same ideas the Designer pane shows). Returns idea ids and labels; apply one with apply_design_idea.

|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes | Path of a .slides.md deck |

Replace a slide with one of the layouts from get_design_ideas. Its text is kept.

|---|---|---|---|

| `slide` | integer | yes | Slide number (1 = first slide, masters not counted) |
